text:
Maya Patel: FYI — we started seeing a small but consistent perf regression after the cuda15 hotpatch rolled to prod-h100 around 09:15 UTC. Small-batch workloads (seq 64/128, dynamic batch sizes <=8) throughput down ~10-13%, p95 up ~18%. KV cache hitrate also dipped ~12% during warmups.

Derek Huang: ugh. Canary didn't catch that?

Maya Patel: Canary on staging showed a tiny blip but we didn't route the same small-batch traffic profile there (mostly large batch tests). The kernel selection trace is interesting — for short sequences we used to pick fused_attn_v2 and now we fall back to matmul_fallback for many layers.

perf-bot: quick profile summary: https://telemetry.internal/runs/2051/hotpatch-compare (flamegraph + kernel picks)

Li Wei: can you paste the selection trace?

Maya Patel: pasted minimal trace below for one request (seq=64):
```
select_kernel(layer=attn, seq_len=64) -> fused_attn_v2 (prev)
select_kernel(layer=attn, seq_len=64) -> matmul_fallback (post-hotpatch)
kv_cache.lookup -> hit-rate 78% (was 90% pre-hotpatch)
p50 latency tokens: 8.6ms -> 9.9ms
throughput tokens/s: 120k -> 104k
```

Natalie Gomez: that sounds like a kernel availability/heuristic change in the driver or cuBLAS alg selection. Did the autotuner re-rank kernels?

Maya Patel: autotuner logs show a different score distribution after the driver updated some kernel attributes. It didn't mark fused_attn_v2 as invalid, but the runtime's selector weight shifted.

Derek Huang: options: 1) rollback driver to previous version on prod nodes, 2) force allowlist/weight to prefer fused_attn_v2 in runtime config, 3) adjust autotuner thresholds and push patched heuristic. Which is fastest?

Maya Patel: fastest is runtime config toggle or a hotpatch that forces kernel preference per-arch. We have a runtime flag to prefer specific kernels: `--kernel-allowlist=fused_attn_v2` or set `KERNEL_PRIORITY=fused_attn_v2`.

Li Wei: can we canary the runtime toggle without touching drivers? I'd prefer that first. If we can flip per-pool, do 1% traffic and compare. Also need to validate KV cache hit delta isn't caused by caching change in runtime.

Maya Patel: agree. Proposed plan:
1) Create canary pool `canary-cuda15-fused-pref` on existing nodes and set `--kernel-allowlist=fused_attn_v2` + keep other heuristics same.
2) Route 2% of small-batch production traffic to canary for 30m.
3) Monitor p50/p95, throughput, kv_hitrate, and error rates.
4) If metrics good, widen to 20% then full. If not, rollback config and prepare driver rollback play.

Derek Huang: make sure to tag runtime, infra, and oncall. Also add a synthetic that exercises seq=64, batch sizes 1..8.

Natalie Gomez: I can add the synthetic. Li, can you create the canary? If you need infra help ping ops-bot.

Li Wei: on it. Creating pool and routing rule now. Will post link when ready.

ops-bot: @Li Wei created pool `canary-cuda15-fused-pref` in prod-us-west-2, 2 nodes reserved. Routing rule `route_smallbatch_to_canary` queued.

deploy-bot: canary toggle applied to pool `canary-cuda15-fused-pref`: `--kernel-allowlist=fused_attn_v2`.

Maya Patel: initial 15m look: p50 in canary matches pre-hotpatch baseline, p95 improved vs the non-canary hotpatched nodes. KV hitrate on canary 89% vs 76% on hotpatched baseline.

Derek Huang: promising. If canary keeps holding, we can push runtime config cluster-wide as short-term mitigation while infra plans driver rollback if needed. Note driver rollback is heavier: needs node reimage or coordinated driver package revert.

Li Wei: I'll keep the canary running for 2 hours and gather histograms. Any objections to promoting to 10% after 30m?

Natalie Gomez: go ahead after 30m if metrics stable. I'll watch evals and synthetic.

Maya Patel: created ticket INF-2389 for rollback plan (if needed). Assigning Derek to driver rollback prep and Li for canary follow-ups.

Derek Huang: I'll prep the rollback playbook (reimage steps, kernel/driver pkg pinned, smoke tests). ETA 2 hours.

Maya Patel: thanks all. Action items: Li -> canary + metrics, Derek -> rollback playbook, Natalie -> synths + evals, Maya -> monitor and coordinate customer-facing comms if we need to widen. :eyes: :pray:

perf-bot: perf alerts will silence for this thread during canary to avoid noise. Link to dashboard: https://monitoring.internal/d/redwood/perf?var=pool=canary-cuda15-fused-pref

ops-bot: routing rule `route_smallbatch_to_canary` active.

Natalie Gomez: 30m update — canary p50/p95 steady, no error spike, synth pass. Proceeding to 10% now.

Li Wei: 2h update — canary stable at 10%, backing proposal to roll runtime config to 100% as short-term mitigation. Filing RFC for autotuner weight patch as long-term fix.

Maya Patel: rolling to 100% now as mitigation. We'll keep driver rollback playbook ready in case there are regressions post-rollout.

Derek Huang: thanks team. If anyone sees anomalies ping #eng-oncall and @sre.
